statements.__comment__: Link KubernetesContainer to NaisDeployment via image digest. Traverses KubernetesContainer.status_image_sha -> NaisApp.image_digest -> NaisApp -[:ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT]-> NaisDeployment. This gives a direct, cryptographically-exact provenance edge: for any running container we know exactly which deployment produced it.
statements.query: MATCH (c:KubernetesContainer)<-[:RUNS_IMAGE]-(a:NaisApp)-[:ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT]->(d:NaisDeployment) WHERE c.status_image_sha IS NOT NULL AND a.image_digest IS NOT NULL AND c.status_image_sha = a.image_digest MERGE (c)-[r:DEPLOYED_BY]->(d) ON CREATE SET r.firstseen = timestamp() SET r.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG
MATCH (c:KubernetesContainer)-[r:DEPLOYED_BY]->(d:NaisDeployment) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE r RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
